__doc__: Cardmarket expansion name -> YGOPRODeck set code, for the sets the card-list matcher cannot place or places on the wrong printing. Keys are the name exactly as Cardmarket writes it, minus the trailing product word (Booster, Display, Structure Deck, Box, ...). An override wins outright: the code is taken off whatever the matcher chose. The importer warns about any key that no longer appears in the catalogue. Candidates: node scripts/cardmarket-import.mjs --dry-run --report
